timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹176.89 Cr, net profit ₹29.9 Cr.
RPG Life Sciences Limited shared the Q4 FY26 earnings call audio recording on April 30, 2026, via its website.
RPG Life Sciences Limited posted the transcript of the Q4FY26 earnings call on its website.
On May 25, 2026, RPG Life Sciences submitted its investor presentation for the Annual Investor Conference 2026.

RPG Life Sciences completes API business subsidiarization to RPGAP, raises ₹243.33 Cr from InvAscent, and acquires Actis Generics (₹80 Cr) and Raghava Life Sciences (₹135 Cr) to expand API portfolio and capacity.
RPG Life Sciences Limited schedules earnings call for Q2 and H1 FY27 results on October 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM IST, hosted virtually by **Ashok Nair (MD)** and **Amol Lone (CFO)**.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹211.64 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹26.6 Cr.
RPG Life Sciences Limited shared the audio recording of its Q2 FY27 results earnings call held on October 30, 2026, at 5:00 PM IST, available on its website.
